findings.title: one digest: declaredScope resolves the change's own scope for every caller, verified by value across no-inputs, null, empty and declared, including the amendment paths that default inputs to {}
the execute gate exists: executableContractProblems is one definition shared by stage execute, evidence begin and archive, and the docstring and skill text now describe the gate that exists

lane changes are appended to lanes/L-nn.json with previous, direction and forced, and a forced downgrade is refused once any review is on record; the lanes record and the manifest are two writes under one lock, lanes first, so a crash over-records rather than under-records
a scope amendment is held to the recorded lane's reviews, and approvalChain passes the lane it is evaluating under, so a link reviewed at a cheaper lane fails a chain re-evaluated at a higher one

the dashboard save allow-list rejects reserved .md under verify/, reviews/, amendments/, findings/, usage/ and migration/; this also closes the residual that laneApproval's amendment selector filters by id alone
eventFile appends a digest of the id whenever sanitizing changed it, so two ids cannot collide

the execute gate read a multi-file intent outside the intent lock, unlike every other read path in spec.mjs; fixed after this review by moving both checks inside the mutate callback so the read holds the lock the write takes
--force on stage meant three things at once, so recovering an expired lease silently waived the contract gate; fixed after this review by giving the waiver its own --skip-contract-gate flag

the task number stays in the acceptance target as C-03 authorizes; the architect asks that design.md's Risks section record the consequence that a pure renumber costs a full re-review plus fresh evidence, which is deferred because any edit to design.md now invalidates this approval
every change is born with review null, so the undeclared default is more load-bearing now that three gates short-circuit on it; recorded for follow-ups rather than changed in this delivery
